messages.label: any account in this currency with Balance != 0 or HeldAmount != 0?
messages.note: SpecListAccounts(currency: code) — a different aggregate than the one being deactivated

messages.label: none found
messages.note: Otherwise refused: 422 CURRENCY_HOLDS_BALANCE, and the currency is left active

cards.title: Why this route stays hand-written
items: The refusal reads Account, not Currency — a generated [CrudAction] handler can only see the aggregate it mutates
The entity method Deactivate() itself carries no guard at all

cards.title: What this can't show
items: Existing accounts and postings already in this currency keep working unchanged
Only a NEW account open (UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY) is refused going forward
